g.text: Publishing a team — the transitions that existed, and the two that did not
a publication is the config record at rkey
; the account and handle are separate, and survive it
— one way in, no way back
removed from the wallet's team index
replies from a dashboard it no longer appears in
a later deploy minted a new uri
the config record still names the old one
— a toggle, and a deletion that reaches both stores
re-points the record at the current uri
Deleting the atproto account would also stop the
mentions, and it is the wrong operation: it frees the handle irreversibly, so anyone
may take it. "Stop responding" should not mean "surrender your name". The credential
on chain is not removed either, because it
firesky tokens in a stack exposing only
permanent history; what varies is whether the config record is present, and that is
answering, but not the current build
wrong: a dead end, or a team that outlived itself
